recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: A recipe is a YAML pipeline: steps run top to bottom on every image.
recipes.builtin_note: Built-in recipe — saving creates a user copy that overrides it.
models.title: Models
models.intro: Weights download once, are checksum-verified, and never leave this machine. Only permissively-licensed models ship in the catalog.
models.unpinned: No pinned checksum in this build
watch.title: Watch folders
watch.intro: Batchroom watches these folders and runs a recipe on every file that appears. Configure them in data/watch.yaml, then reload.
watch.howto: Dropped files wait until fully copied, are processed with the recipe, then move to done/ or failed/ next to the folder. Outputs and manifest.json land in the output directory.

tour.title: Welcome to Batchroom
tour.intro: Everything runs here, on this server — nothing is uploaded to a cloud.
tour.step1: Drop images on the Process page and pick a recipe: a ready-made pipeline such as background removal + resize + export pack.
tour.step2: Follow progress live in the Queue — every image reports its current step, and you can cancel anytime.
tour.step3: Open a finished job to compare before/after with the slider and download the results as a ZIP.
